newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end down, Reliance bucks trend.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end down, Reliance bucks trend.

text.p: Delhi share prices closed slightly lower in mixed trade on Monday but Reliance Industries surged on foreign buying and speculative purchases, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 1.86 points lower at 802.49.
Reliance Industries jumped five rupees to 310.40 on anticipation that the company might announce a bonus issue, brokers said.

"Foreign investors were major participants in today's trading as they made heavy purchases in Reliance Industries while other players stayed on the sidelines," said Bharat Bhushan of brokers Nu-Era Equities.
State Bank of India rose 0.75 rupee to 314.25.
Traders said selling by domestic financial institution Unit Trust of India (UTI) pulled down share prices.
TISCO dropped 2.90 rupees to 170.10 on selling by domestic financial institutions, brokers said.
